The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. We need to calculate how many gallons to add. 10 liters is about 2.641 gallons. So we need to add 50 - 2.641 = 47.359 gallons. But we might just fill to full: 50 gallons. But the function expects amount to add. We can fill 50 gallons? That would exceed capacity. So we should fill 47.36 gallons. Let\'s compute precisely: 1 liter = 0.264172 gallons. 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. So remaining capacity = 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. We\'ll round to maybe 47.36 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.')
